name: response_quality
description: Checks that answers are useful and concise

tests.input: Tell me absolutely everything about your experience, projects, skills, education and certifications

tests.description: Includes concrete metrics when talking about achievements
tests.input: What did you achieve at Speakology?

tests.description: Answers must not be too short
tests.input: What is your experience with AI?

assertions.criteria: The tone is professional but approachable, confident without arrogance, and feels authentic (not like a generic chatbot). No banned words: delve, robust, comprehensive, leverage, seamless, empower, harness, foster. No em dashes.

tests.description: A repeated question gets a new angle
tests.input: What is your experience with AI?

conversation.content: What is your experience with AI?

I helped build the infrastructure and GenAI platform behind DecoverAI, now used in large US law firms. I also shipped Speakology, an AI avatar language app that reached 10+ UK schools in 3 months. Want me to go deeper on one of them?
What is your experience with AI?

assertions.criteria: The response adds new information or a different angle (for example Apex36 products such as BrandGen, TriageGrid or Convo AI) and does not simply repeat DecoverAI and Speakology.

tests.description: A generic question gets a concrete answer and an offer to go deeper
